Subject: Request for Quotation — {RFQ_NUMBER} | Osman Interlinings Limited (OIL)
Dear {SUPPLIER_CONTACT_NAME}, Greetings from Osman Interlinings Limited (OIL). We invite you to submit your quotation for our procurement requirements under RFQ Reference No. {RFQ_NUMBER}. Please review the RFQ details and submit your competitive offer through the secure link provided below. RFQ Details: RFQ Reference: {RFQ_NUMBER} Product/Material: {PRODUCTS} Quotation Deadline: {RFQ_DEADLINE_CHINA} (China Standard Time) · {RFQ_DEADLINE_BD} Quotation Submission Link: {RFQ_LINK} Quotation Requirements — please provide through the RFQ portal: 1. Unit Price and Currency 2. Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) 3. Available Stock and Production Lead Time 4. Delivery Schedule 5. Incoterms and Port of Shipment 6. Payment Terms 7. Quotation Validity 8. Product Specifications and Supporting Documents Important Instructions: • Submit your quotation within the specified deadline. • The secure RFQ link is exclusively assigned to your organization. • Quotations submitted after the deadline may not be considered. • All quotations will be evaluated on commercial terms, product quality, delivery capability and other relevant criteria. Best regards, Procurement Department Osman Interlinings Limited (OIL) {CONTACT_EMAIL} This is a system-generated RFQ invitation from the OIL Procurement Management System.
